description: American-built 1958 Bell 47 presented to President Sukarno in 1960; the presidential helicopter known as 'Si Walet'. Displayed in red and white with Garuda Pancasila upholstery. Registration not published by the museum.
Full-size mock-up of a presidential Boeing 737-200 built as a walk-through exhibit in the museum's 'Runway 27' zone, not a real airframe.
